Traveling with Apple devices usually means lugging around a ton of charging cables and outlet adapters. The RORRY Flow power bank consolidates everything you need into one compact charger, solving all your problems at once. It features built-in foldable prongs, an integrated USB-C cable, and a magnetic charger designed specifically for the Apple Watch. This is hands down my favourite travel accessory, handling everything from quick top-ups on the go to overnight charging with ease.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers breaks down the latest developments in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry, helping you get the most out of the wireless charging capabilities of your Apple devices.

Built for travel

The RORRY Flow power bank has built-in foldable wall prongs on the back, so there's no need to carry a separate plug to charge the power bank — just plug it straight into the wall socket at your hotel or holiday rental. It also comes with a built-in USB-C cable (which I absolutely love!), meaning you won't need to pack an extra cable even if you want to charge your iPhone, iPad, Kindle, Switch, and more.

Although I usually focus on MagSafe for iPhone, this power bank features a 5W magnetic charging module designed specifically for the Apple Watch. When your Apple Watch is running low on battery, you just pop it on for an effortless top-up — incredibly convenient. It holds the watch securely, so you can charge it without carrying the original charger.

This power bank has a capacity of 10,000 mAh, more than enough to keep your iPhone and Apple Watch going through a full day of travel. For me, the most practical feature is its 40W USB-C output, which is enough to top up a closed MacBook Air in an emergency.

RORRY Flow power bank wrap-up

If you want to lighten your travel load when carrying Apple devices, the RORRY Flow power bank is a solid choice. It combines a wall charger, an Apple Watch charging cable, and a USB-C cable into one, with a minimalist design that slips easily into a backpack or pocket.

You can pick up the RORRY Flow portable charger directly from RORRY or Amazon.
